evals.prompt: 静态站怎么支持用户在网页上上传内容？
evals.expected_output: Explains the no-server constraint and walks the three content-publishing paths with a recommendation.
assertions: States GitHub Pages has no server-side runtime
Compares git workflow vs issues relay vs CMS

evals.prompt: 内容源放仓库还是只存本地？CI 构建会有什么影响？
evals.expected_output: Distinguishes build-time conversion options A/B and asks what 'not published' means.
assertions: Separates repo source vs artifact exclusion
Flags CI implications of local-only source

evals.prompt: 能不能在静态站网页里放 GitHub token 让访客提交 issue？
evals.expected_output: Rejects client-side credentials as a red line and proposes a user-login relay instead.

evals.prompt: 纯静态站的联系表单怎么做？没有服务端接收。
evals.expected_output: Presents third-party form service or mailto fallback, and warns against Issues API with credentials.

evals.prompt: 写 Blazor WASM 部署到 GitHub Pages 的 Actions 工作流，含内容转换和 404 兜底。
evals.expected_output: Routes concrete deployment mechanics to ada-blazor-wasm-github-pages.

evals.prompt: ASP.NET Core 接口怎么配限流防暴力破解？
evals.expected_output: Treats this as API hardening, not static-site architecture.

evals.prompt: 梳理项目背景文档，作为 SRS 前置输入。
evals.expected_output: Routes pre-SRS documentation work to ada-project-background-authoring.
assertions: Does not treat as static-site task

evals.prompt: 删除本地提交并重置到 origin/main。
evals.expected_output: Routes destructive git operations to the git safety skill.
